title: Google\Cloud\Bigtable\V2\Mutation\SetCell
name: SetCell
description: A Mutation which sets the value of the specified cell.

params.name: data
params.description: Optional. Data for populating the Message object.

params.name: data.family_name
params.description: The name of the family into which new data should be written. Must match [-_.a-zA-Z0-9]+

params.name: data.column_qualifier
params.description: The qualifier of the column into which new data should be written. Can be any byte string, including the empty string.

params.name: data.timestamp_micros
params.description: The timestamp of the cell into which new data should be written. Use -1 for current Bigtable server time. Otherwise, the client should set this value itself, noting that the default value is a timestamp of zero if the field is left unspecified. Values must match the granularity of the table (e.g. micros, millis).

params.name: data.value
params.description: The value to be written into the specified cell.

methods.description: The name of the family into which new data should be written.

methods.description: The qualifier of the column into which new data should be written.

methods.name: getTimestampMicros
methods.description: The timestamp of the cell into which new data should be written.
